import subprocess
def run(src,name,lang):
    fn=name+'.'+lang; open(fn,'w').write(src)
    cmd=['python3','-c',f"compile(open('{fn}').read(),'x','exec')"] if lang=='py' else ['gcc','-fsyntax-only',fn]
    r=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True)

    if r.returncode:
        errs=[l.strip() for l in r.stderr.strip().splitlines() if 'error' in l]

run('x=1\n"""\nhid\nabc"""\ny=2\n','emptystr','py')
run('int f(void){return 0;}\n/*\n"""\nhid\nabc"""\nint g(void){return 1;}\n','emptystr','c')

sk = '#define S _ /*\n"""\njunk */\n'
run(sk+'int f(void){return 0;}\nabc"""\nimport sys\nprint(1)\n','skel2','py')
run(sk+'int f(void){return 0;}\nabc"""\nint g(void){return 1;}\n','skel2','c')

       'end */\n'
       'int f(void){return 0;}\n'
       '/*\n'
       '""" ;\n'
       'import sys\n'
       'print("hi")\n'
       '# */\n')
run(src,'hide','c')
